Iranians know how the rest of the world functions thanks to illegal satellite dishes, the internet, and social media (via VPNs). They also download bootleg movies and shows. Once emerged in that, one can understand American pop culture and, to an extent, US domestic politics.

One day we will figure out how the Iranian theocratic government became so good at trolling the US, and that too using US-style pop culture memes and lines.
